# @orchestra/storybook

Storybook workbench for the ui, session-ui and app components.

## Purpose and ownership

- Storybook workbench for the ui, session-ui and app components.
- Owner role: UI maintainer.

## Public entry points and consumers

- Configuration and mocks in `apps/storybook/.storybook`.
- Workflow `.github/workflows/storybook.yml`.

## Dependencies and boundaries

- Layer `app`.
- Dev dependencies `@orchestra/ui` and `@orchestra/session-ui`.

## Assets, schemas and generated files

- Mocks under `apps/storybook/.storybook/mocks/app` alias app-shell modules.

## Persistence, identity and lifetime

- None.

## Commands

- `bun run storybook`
- `bun run build`
- There is no typecheck script.

## Contracts and verification limits

- One mock imports the vendored upstream client tarball without declaring it; that import is a declared exception (rule R4) in `script/boundary-ledger.json`.
